mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP2C9) which metabolize naproxen, potentially increasing naproxen levels and toxicity risk; concurrent use also increases GI irritation and hepatotoxicity risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest effective naproxen dose with gastroprotection and monitor for increased adverse effects including GI bleeding and hepatic function.
